references.text: Verse 27 shows the violent execution of the plan mentioned in verse 13 and confirms that the motive of revenge drove the entire action.
Verse 5 establishes the fathers' silent reaction to the disgrace, while verse 13 shows the sons' active revenge, creating a theological contrast in how the family handled injustice.
Verse 6 describes Hamor's attempt at negotiation, which directly leads to the cunning response in verse 13.
Verse 26 is the concrete execution of the cunning plan described in verse 13.
Verse 4 describes the original disgrace that was the direct cause of the sons' cunning response in verse 13.
